name: Ensemble accusation

shots.title: The Letter on the Table
shots.sourceExcerpt:
## INT. COUNCIL ROOM - NIGHT

Five council members sit together. Mara stands alone at the open end of their table. Len places a sealed letter in front of her.
shots.description: Opening composition: a wide, symmetrical frame from behind and above Mara's shoulder line at the open end of the table. Five council members sit together along the far sides of the table, facing toward her. Mara stands alone in the near foreground, seen partly from behind. The camera drifts slowly forward along the table's axis as Len rises slightly, reaches across, and places a sealed letter on the table in front of Mara. Ending composition: a medium-wide frame centred on the letter now resting before Mara, with Len's hand withdrawing and the seated council blurred beyond.
shots.atmosphere: Night interior, low pools of lamplight over the table, deep shadows around the room's edges, formal and tense stillness.
shots.music: Near silence; a faint, low sustained string tone.

shots.title: Len's Accusation
shots.description: Opening composition: a reverse angle, a medium close-up of Len seated among the council, looking up toward Mara, the camera placed at Mara's standing eyeline and angled slightly down. Other council members sit soft-focus at the frame edges. Len speaks evenly, eyes fixed on Mara. The camera holds static. Ending composition: Len holds Mara's gaze in silence after the line.
shots.atmosphere: Hushed, cold authority; lamplight catching one side of Len's face.
shots.music: The low tone continues, barely audible.

shots.title: Mara's Answer
shots.sourceExcerpt:
### MARA

Then someone has learned both.
shots.description: Opening composition: a close-up of Mara standing, shot from a low angle near the seated council's eyeline, looking down toward Len. She glances briefly at the sealed letter, then back up to Len, and answers. Static camera. Ending composition: Mara's steady close-up, unmoving, after the line.
shots.atmosphere: Controlled defiance; Mara's face half-lit, shadow behind her.
shots.music: The tone drops away to silence.

shots.title: The Youngest Looks to Len
shots.sourceExcerpt: The youngest councillor looks at Len. One by one the others turn their chairs away from Mara. Mara stays standing.
shots.description: Opening composition: a medium side-on profile shot of the youngest councillor seated at the table, initially looking toward Mara off-screen. The youngest councillor's eyes turn to Len, who sits soft-focus in the background of the frame. The camera holds static. Ending composition: the youngest councillor's look settles on Len, with Len in the background.
shots.atmosphere: Uncertain, a silent search for direction.

shots.title: Chairs Turn Away
shots.sourceExcerpt: The youngest councillor looks at Len. One by one the others turn their chairs away from Mara. Mara stays standing.
shots.description: Opening composition: a wide frame from Mara's end of the table, close behind her shoulder, looking down the length of the table at all five council members. One by one, the council members turn their chairs away from Mara, the chair legs scraping in sequence. The camera remains fixed as each turning figure presents its back. Ending composition: a row of chair backs and turned shoulders facing away from Mara, with the sealed letter still on the table in the foreground.
shots.atmosphere: A heavy, ritual rejection; each chair scrape rings in the quiet room.
shots.music: Silence, broken only by the chairs; a single deep note enters at the last turn.

shots.title: Mara Stays Standing
shots.sourceExcerpt: The youngest councillor looks at Len. One by one the others turn their chairs away from Mara. Mara stays standing.
shots.description: Opening composition: a high, wide frame from the far end of the room, looking past the council's turned backs toward Mara, who stands alone at the open end of the table. Mara remains standing, unmoving. The camera slowly pushes in over the turned chairs toward her. Ending composition: a medium shot of Mara alone and upright, framed between the council's turned backs.
shots.atmosphere: Isolation and quiet resolve; Mara in the last pool of lamplight.
shots.music: The deep note sustains and slowly fades.
